from pathlib import Path
import math
import numpy as np
import cv2
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
from artifact_io import save

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W,H=256,144

def shifted(a,dx,dy,sx=1.,sy=1.,cx=148.,cy=34.,angle=0):
    co,si=math.cos(angle),math.sin(angle)
    A=np.array([[sx*co,-sy*si,cx+dx-sx*co*cx+sy*si*cy],
                [sx*si,sy*co,cy+dy-sx*si*cx-sy*co*cy]],np.float32)
    return cv2.warpAffine(a,A,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT)

def paper_sprite():
    # An irregular folded ball of paper; small softened planar creases.
    ss=6
    p=Image.new('RGBA',(W*ss,H*ss))
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(p)
    points=[(-7,-8),(-3,-11),(2,-10),(5,-8),(7,-3),(8,2),(5,7),(1,10),(-4,8),(-7,4),(-8,-2)]
    v=[(148+x,34+y) for x,y in points]
    inner=[(144,30),(149,28),(153,33),(150,38),(145,40),(142,35)]
    def poly(v,col):d.polygon([(round(x*ss),round(y*ss)) for x,y in v],fill=col)
    poly(v,(169,170,153,255))
    # Outer triangular folds with directional, soft ivory illumination.
    c=[(184,185,167,255),(201,201,181,255),(181,183,165,255),
       (158,162,148,255),(185,187,170,255),(162,169,157,255),
       (151,159,148,255),(178,181,162,255),(142,152,143,255),
       (156,163,149,255),(186,187,168,255)]
    for j in range(len(v)):
        poly([v[j],v[(j+1)%len(v)],inner[int(j/len(v)*len(inner))]],c[j])
    poly([inner[0],inner[1],inner[2],(148,34)],(202,201,178,255))
    poly([inner[0],(148,34),inner[5]],(174,177,156,255))
    poly([inner[2],inner[3],(148,34)],(154,164,150,255))
    poly([inner[3],inner[4],inner[5],(148,34)],(191,192,169,255))
    for a,b in [(inner[0],(148,34)),((148,34),inner[2]),((148,34),inner[3]),(inner[4],inner[5])]:
        d.line([(int(a[0]*ss),int(a[1]*ss)),(int(b[0]*ss),int(b[1]*ss))],fill=(139,151,138,120),width=2)
    p=p.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.55))
    arr=np.array(p).astype(np.float32)
    return arr[:,:,:3],arr[:,:,3]/255

def generate():
    image=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
    im=image.astype(np.float32)
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[:H,:W]
    # Recover the clear wall visible around the initially suspended paper,
    # retaining the stationary white reflections on the glass.
    region=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8)
    outline=np.array([(143,13),(150,14),(154,20),(158,26),(160,35),
        (157,46),(151,54),(143,51),(137,45),(134,36),(137,26),(140,21)],np.int32)
    cv2.fillPoly(region,[outline],255)
    region=cv2.GaussianBlur(region,(7,7),1.3).astype(float)/255
    field=im.copy()
    for x in range(131,164):
        for y in range(10,61):
            field[y,x]=np.array([136.5,146.,132.5])+(x-147)*np.array([-.32,-.42,-.32])+(y-40)*np.array([-.045,-.02,-.01])
    delta=im.mean(2)-field.mean(2)
    glint=np.clip((delta-7)/30,0,1)
    glint*=(((xx>140)&(xx<155)&(yy<43))|((xx<141)&(yy<31)))
    a=region*(1-glint)
    glass=im*(1-a[:,:,None])+field*a[:,:,None]
    original_paper=im-glass
    # Masks for the two short grabber jaws. The tool retracts out of frame.
    jaw_masks=[]
    for poly in [[(127,0),(138,0),(138,10),(136,18),(132,19),(129,15)],
                 [(156,0),(166,0),(166,7),(164,17),(161,21),(157,19),(155,12)]]:
        m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8)
        cv2.fillPoly(m,[np.array(poly,np.int32)],255)
        jaw_masks.append(m)
    toolmask=np.maximum(*jaw_masks)
    empty=cv2.inpaint(np.uint8(np.clip(glass,0,255)),toolmask,3,cv2.INPAINT_TELEA).astype(float)
    # Re-establish rim where the jaw hid a few pixels of its elliptical lip.
    top=Image.new('RGBA',(W*4,H*4))
    dr=ImageDraw.Draw(top)
    dr.arc((127*4,1*4,172*4,12*4),185,345,fill=(86,99,95,140),width=3)
    top=np.array(top.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)).astype(float)
    rim_a=top[:,:,3]/255*(toolmask/255)
    empty=empty*(1-rim_a[:,:,None])+top[:,:,:3]*rim_a[:,:,None]
    tool_layers=[(glass-empty)*(m[:,:,None]/255) for m in jaw_masks]
    rgb,pa=paper_sprite()
    # Front glass glare dims objects slightly but remains fixed in the frame.
    glint_front=np.clip((im.mean(2)-155)/95,0,.70)*((xx>135)&(xx<166)&(yy<76))
    frames=[image]
    for i in range(1,20):
        t=i/4
        f=empty.copy()
        # During opening, the jaws move very slightly apart, then lift away.
        lift=-max(0,t-.25)*32
        spread=min(t/.35,1)*1.3
        for j,tool in enumerate(tool_layers):
            f+=shifted(tool,(-1 if j==0 else 1)*spread,lift)
        # A short free fall followed by a damped bob at the marked surface.
        if t<.66:
            fall=94*t*t
            sy=1-.25*min(t/.65,1)
            sx=1-.07*min(t/.65,1)
            cx=148+1.4*t
            cy=34+fall
            ang=.13*math.sin(t*5)
        else:
            q=t-.66
            cy=76.2+1.7*math.exp(-q*2.4)*math.sin(q*7)+.30*(1-math.exp(-q))
            cx=149.0+1.1*(1-math.exp(-q*.8))+.18*math.sin(q*2)
            sx=.90
            sy=.63+.06*math.exp(-q*2)
            ang=.11+.025*math.exp(-q)*math.sin(q*6)
        dx,dy=cx-148,cy-34
        source=shifted(original_paper,dx,dy,sx,sy,angle=ang)
        mix=np.clip((t-.18)/.65,0,1)
        f+=source*(1-mix)
        alpha=shifted(pa,dx,dy,sx,sy,angle=ang)
        premul=shifted(rgb*pa[:,:,None],dx,dy,sx,sy,angle=ang)
        col=premul/np.maximum(alpha[:,:,None],1e-5)
        # Absorption and refraction in the liquid reduce whiteness under water.
        sub=np.clip((yy-78.4)/5.5,0,1)
        col=col*(1-.58*sub[:,:,None])+np.array([19,111,127])*(.58*sub[:,:,None])
        alpha*=mix*(1-.20*sub)
        alpha*=1-glint_front
        # The opaque green level band in front of the paper remains unchanged.
        band=((yy>=80)&(yy<=86)&(xx>=125)&(xx<=172))
        alpha*=1-band
        f=f*(1-alpha[:,:,None])+col*alpha[:,:,None]
        if t>=.6:
            q=max(0,t-.6)
            # Small spreading surface rings, flattened in perspective and
            # partially hidden behind the green marking; no large splash.
            rings=Image.new('RGBA',(W*4,H*4))
            rd=ImageDraw.Draw(rings)
            for k in range(2):
                rad=4+q*13-k*4.5
                opacity=int(65*math.exp(-q*3)*max(0,1-k*.4))
                if 2<rad<23 and opacity>1:
                    rd.ellipse(((cx-rad)*4,(78.2-rad*.085)*4,(cx+rad)*4,(78.2+rad*.085)*4),outline=(141,177,160,opacity),width=2)
            ar=np.array(rings.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)).astype(float)
            ra=ar[:,:,3]/255
            ra*=((xx>126)&(xx<171)&(yy<81))
            f=f*(1-ra[:,:,None])+ar[:,:,:3]*ra[:,:,None]
        frames.append(np.uint8(np.clip(np.rint(f),0,255)))
    return np.stack(frames)

if __name__=='__main__':
    save(generate(),ROOT)

"""Output-only helpers. No drawing or generation policy is implemented here."""
from pathlib import Path
import base64
import json
import wave

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):
    case_dir = Path(case_dir)
    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))
    data = {
        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }
    template = (Path(__file__).parent / "player_template.html").read_text()
    payload = json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    (case_dir / "index.html").write_text(template.replace("__ID__", case_dir.name).replace("__DATA__", payload))

            cx=148+1.4*t
            cy=34+fall
            ang=.13*math.sin(t*5)
        else:
            q=t-.66
            cy=76.2+1.7*math.exp(-q*2.4)*math.sin(q*7)+.30*(1-math.exp(-q))
            cx=149.0+1.1*(1-math.exp(-q*.8))+.18*math.sin(q*2)
            sx=.90
            sy=.63+.06*math.exp(-q*2)
            ang=.11+.025*math.exp(-q)*math.sin(q*6)
        dx,dy=cx-148,cy-34
        source=shifted(original_paper,dx,dy,sx,sy,angle=ang)
        mix=np.clip((t-.18)/.65,0,1)
        f+=source*(1-mix)
        alpha=shifted(pa,dx,dy,sx,sy,angle=ang)
        premul=shifted(rgb*pa[:,:,None],dx,dy,sx,sy,angle=ang)
        col=premul/np.maximum(alpha[:,:,None],1e-5)
        # Absorption and refraction in the liquid reduce whiteness under water.
        sub=np.clip((yy-78.4)/5.5,0,1)
        col=col*(1-.58*sub[:,:,None])+np.array([19,111,127])*(.58*sub[:,:,None])
        alpha*=mix*(1-.20*sub)
        alpha*=1-glint_front
        # The opaque green level band in front of the paper remains unchanged.
        band=((yy>=80)&(yy<=86)&(xx>=125)&(xx<=172))
        alpha*=1-band
        f=f*(1-alpha[:,:,None])+col*alpha[:,:,None]
        if t>=.6:
            q=max(0,t-.6)
            # Small spreading surface rings, flattened in perspective and
            # partially hidden behind the green marking; no large splash.
            rings=Image.new('RGBA',(W*4,H*4))
            rd=ImageDraw.Draw(rings)
            for k in range(2):
                rad=4+q*13-k*4.5
                opacity=int(65*math.exp(-q*3)*max(0,1-k*.4))
                if 2<rad<23 and opacity>1:
                    rd.ellipse(((cx-rad)*4,(78.2-rad*.085)*4,(cx+rad)*4,(78.2+rad*.085)*4),outline=(141,177,160,opacity),width=2)
            ar=np.array(rings.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)).astype(float)
            ra=ar[:,:,3]/255
            ra*=((xx>126)&(xx<171)&(yy<81))
            f=f*(1-ra[:,:,None])+ar[:,:,:3]*ra[:,:,None]
        frames.append(np.uint8(np.clip(np.rint(f),0,255)))
    return np.stack(frames)

if __name__=='__main__':
    save(generate(),ROOT)
